name: Wrought Knuckle
description: Hammer a knuckle of hard qi onto the fist and strike through the guard.

name: Beaten Plate
description: Hammer a broad plate of qi out of the air before the chest.

name: Rivet Stride
description: Make a stud of qi in the ground and push off it into a quick pace.

name: Temper Grip
description: Make the grip of the hand tough and sure so a weapon cannot be wrenched free.

name: Wrought Slab
description: Hammer a tall wall of qi from the ground to stop a charge of several foes.

name: Wrought Hammer
description: Make a heavy hammer of qi and bring it down in one smashing blow.

name: Step Slab
description: Make a flat slab of qi under the foot and ride it a pace across the ground.

name: Slab Strike
description: Make a slab beside the fist and swing the whole weight of it into the foe.

name: Tread Brace
description: Make firm footing under both feet so a hard shove cannot unseat the stance.

name: Footing Fix
description: Fix the ground beneath a fighter in place so their stance gains weight and poise.

name: Furrow Snare
description: Make a shallow furrow across a running foe's path so the stride catches in it.

name: Raised Barrier
description: Raise a long low barrier of made stone that blocks a line of attackers.

name: Sunken Floor
description: Unmake the footing under a foe so the ground drops half a pace beneath them.

name: Kindle Palm
description: Kindle a bright knot of new force in the palm and strike with it.

name: Kindle Guard
description: Kindle a flash of force at the forearm that pushes a blow off its line.

name: Kindle Stride
description: Kindle a push of force at the heel and cover a long pace.

name: Kindle Mend
description: Kindle warm new force in a hurt limb to close small cuts and ease the pain.

name: Kindle Bolt
description: Kindle a bolt of force in the hand and throw it at a distant foe.

name: Kindle Burst
description: Kindle a burst of new force that blows outward and flings those nearby back.

name: Remake Skin
description: Make new skin over a torn patch of flesh on an ally or the user.

name: Stanch Flow
description: Make a plug of new flesh in a bleeding cut to hold the blood in the body.

name: Quick Guard
description: Make a hard shell of qi across the back of the hand to take a stab.

name: Rebuilt Fist
description: Make the fist dense and whole as if newly built and strike with its fresh weight.

name: Sure Stride
description: Make the leg strong and light for one pace and lengthen the step.

name: Purge Taint
description: Make clean blood in the veins of an ally and drive poison or taint out through the skin.

name: Remake Bone
description: Make new bone about a clean break in an ally's limb and knit it whole.
